entities.summary: Zvi Greengold is a former Israel Defense Forces (IDF) officer who fought during the 1973 Yom Kippur War as a tank commander. He is one of only eight people who fought in the war to be awarded the Medal of Valor, the nation's highest medal for heroism. He is a former mayor of Ofakim. Zvika Greengold was a military leaders & commanders from Lohamei HaGeta'ot (b. 1952-02-10, Lohamei HaGeta'ot). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to geopolitics.
